decision: User approved the fixed 200 versus 1000 update two-run CPU contrast and at most 19296 top-level forwards, with results publication.

dataset.reuse: Exact stored original dataset bytes, label indices, features, footprints and order; no regeneration, domain, reference or new examples

input.construction: Unchanged encodeDecision 52 features + actionOutcome 22 features for every legal candidate + encodeFootprints binary geometry; no target, label, key, fixture id or reference score enters forward
input.shortcut: Outcome feature index 52 is clearedRows/16 and separates the unique target in every example; fitting cannot establish spatial reasoning or residual necessity

model.initialization: Cold same-seed make_model spatial; unchanged zero-initialized residual output; no old checkpoint load

shared.loss: Mean native float32 cross_entropy over all 31 original candidates for each of 16 observations; flat loss only
shared.order: Fixed increasing row order; one optimizer update after all 16 per-example forward/backward operations
shared.selection: Unchanged raw full-list logits argmax, first original legal index on ties; no score scaling, temperature or routing
shared.marginRule: Every target logit minus highest non-target logit must be strictly greater than zero

contrast.initialization: Two fresh same-seed cold spatial models in sequential child processes; no warm start or checkpoint load
contrast.fixed: Same data, architecture, 74 features, footprint, seed, native flat float32 CE, mean loss, optimizer, learning rate, per-step weight decay and fixed observation order
contrast.selection: Control final step 200 and candidate final step 1000 only; no early stopping, best checkpoint, extra seed, duration sweep or continuation

controls.order: Complete exact 200-update control before creating the 1000-update candidate; mismatch stops the entire run
controls.control: Original initial logical weights/16 initial logits, all 200 mean training losses, final logical weights/16 final logits/predictions/metrics and two repeats exact; checkpoint serialization bytes and runtime metadata need not match
controls.candidateInitial: Same initial logical weights and 16 logits as original and concurrent control, with no extra preflight model or forwards
controls.candidatePrefix200: First 200 pre-update mean losses and step-200 logical model weights exact to original and concurrent control; step-200 optimizer state fingerprint exact to concurrent control
controls.optimizerFingerprint: Record a canonical logical optimizer-state fingerprint at step 200 in each new arm; original optimizer state was not saved, so no exact original optimizer-state claim
controls.prefixObservations: Hash in-memory weights and optimizer state only, before step 201; no forward, checkpoint load, data-dependent branching or checkpoint reselection

forwardBudget.scope: Reserve before each top-level spatial call; nested common/residual modules are not extra top-level calls. No warmup or other model calls

resources.runtime: Existing CPU PyTorch only; no install, GPU, new service or external data transfer
resources.timing: Child process caps include interpreter/import startup; owner covers read/freeze/orchestration; report Python body timer separately. RSS samples at load/update/evaluation, not instantaneous peak
resources.failure: STOP with original and partial artifacts preserved on hash/control/prefix/finite/ledger/budget/process failure; no retry, restart, sweep or extra update

screening.technical: Approved immutable source/config/data identity, exact original control and candidate prefix, finite values, exact 19296 ledger and final repeated outputs; separate from fitting
screening.fit: Apply unchanged 16/16, mean NLL <= 0.05 and every target margin > 0 independently at each arm final step
screening.durationScreen: Candidate passes every original fit gate, concurrent exact control fails, and candidate mean NLL is lower; all required. Lower NLL or 16/16 alone cannot pass this screen
screening.descriptive: Report paired correct gains/regressions, NLL delta, target margins/ranks/mass, stored pre-update loss milestones and process/body wall-time/RSS; no metric-based reselection
screening.interpretation: A positive duration screen supports sufficiency of the fixed longer update schedule on this fit set only. It does not prove duration was the sole cause; per-step weight decay is unchanged but cumulative regularization and Adam state evolve with more updates
screening.compute: Candidate uses five times the training updates/exposures, not an equal-compute or equal-time policy comparison. Runtime is observed, not predicted from the update ratio
